standard.summary: RS-LoRA 将 LoRA 的缩放因子从 α/r 改为 α/√r，使得不同 rank 下 LoRA 的有效学习率保持一致。解决高 rank 训练不稳定的问题。
standard.effect: 高 rank（>64）训练更稳定，不需要手动降低学习率。低 rank（<32）时效果与标准 LoRA 接近。
standard.whenToUse: 使用高 rank（64-256）训练时推荐。想在不同 rank 之间做公平对比实验时。
standard.avoidWhen: 低 rank（8-32）训练时不需要——标准缩放已经够好。

standard_en.summary: RS-LoRA changes the LoRA's scaling factor from alpha/r to alpha/sqrt(r), so the LoRA's effective learning rate stays consistent across ranks. It solves the instability of high-rank training.
standard_en.effect: High-rank (>64) training is steadier and needs no manual learning-rate reduction. At a low rank (<32) the effect is close to a standard LoRA's.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended when training at a high rank (64-256). When you want a fair comparison between different ranks.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for low-rank (8-32) training -- the standard scaling is already good enough.

advanced.principle: 标准 LoRA scaling = α/r。当 rank 增大时 scaling 减小，等效学习率降低。RS-LoRA scaling = α/√r，rank 增大时 scaling 降低更慢，保持更大的有效学习率。这使得 rank=128 和 rank=32 在相同 lr 下有相似的更新幅度。
advanced.intervention: 修改 LoRA forward 中的 scaling 因子：scaling = alpha / sqrt(rank) 替代 alpha / rank。
advanced.expectedImpact: 高 rank 训练的收敛速度提升，最终质量改善约 2-5%。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 LoRA+ 策略兼容——两者作用在不同层面。
advanced.codePath: networks/lora.py: scaling = alpha / math.sqrt(rank) when rs_lora_enabled

advanced_en.principle: Standard LoRA scaling = α/r. As rank grows, scaling shrinks and the effective learning rate drops. RS-LoRA scaling = α/√r, so scaling decreases more slowly as rank grows, keeping a larger effective learning rate. This makes rank=128 and rank=32 have similar update magnitudes at the same lr.
advanced_en.intervention: Modifies the scaling factor in the LoRA forward: scaling = alpha / sqrt(rank) instead of alpha / rank.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Improves convergence speed for high-rank training; final quality improves by about 2-5%.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Compatible with the LoRA+ strategy — the two act at different layers.
advanced_en.codePath: networks/lora.py: scaling = alpha / math.sqrt(rank) when rs_lora_enabled
